title: Finite normalization of an integral Noetherian curve is a regular birational cover
statement:
Let $C$ be an integral Noetherian scheme of dimension $1$, and let $
u:N=C^
u	o C$ be its normalization in its function field. Suppose $
u$ is finite. Then $N$ is integral, Noetherian and regular of dimension $1$, and $
u$ is surjective and induces an isomorphism $k(C)\xrightarrow{\sim}k(N)$. Here Noetherian means quasi-compact and locally Noetherian; birationality is the displayed isomorphism of function fields. Conventions: [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-sc-normalization], [def-sc-function-field], [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Noetherian scheme conventions: [pqf-def-locnoeth], [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme].
